strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Hardens authorized remote Mode Pack candidate and registry fetches by binding validated DNS resolution to the actual HTTPS request.
Keeps remote fetch trust decisions in the Rust runtime and fails closed before network use when DNS resolution is unsafe or empty.
Records bounded DNS binding fingerprints/counts/family while excluding raw IPs, raw response bodies, raw Mode Pack JSON, raw manifests, paths, commands, prompts, and secrets.
Lets unattended update flows rely on a fetch primitive that cannot validate one DNS answer and connect to another.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances mode_pack_runtime directly, with supporting progress for runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: Authorized remote Mode Pack candidate and registry fetches now use a validated pinned DNS binding before HTTPS request execution.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Existing URL validation resolves and rejects unsafe addresses before fetch, but the HTTP client can resolve the host again when connecting.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Remote Mode Pack trust remains exposed to DNS rebinding or validation/use mismatch before candidate and registry evidence is admitted.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. R4.1, R4.1.1, and R4.2 were headless completion correctness phases; R5.1 hardens remote Mode Pack network fetch authority.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing modepack.fetchCandidate and modepack.selectRegistryUpdate methods change behavior; no method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Bounded DNS binding fields extend existing candidate/selection summaries only as evidence and do not create a standalone wrapper surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime resolves, validates, pins, and uses one address binding for each authorized fetch; unsafe DNS denies before network request or ledger mutation.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless update flows can rely on remote Mode Pack inputs that passed a deterministic runtime fetch trust boundary.
answers.milestone_progress: Opens R5 by closing the first remote-fetch trust-boundary blocker before active candidate identity work.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: R5.1 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the R5.1 value gate. Review must confirm this is runtime remote fetch trust-boundary hardening, not a DNS report wrapper.

exit_criteria: modepack.fetchCandidate creates a validated pinned DNS binding before HTTPS fetch use
modepack.selectRegistryUpdate creates a validated pinned DNS binding before registry HTTPS fetch use
unsafe or empty DNS resolution fails before network request and before candidate or selection ledger mutation
successful candidate and registry fetch summaries include bounded DNS binding fingerprints/counts/family

ledger and RPC evidence exclude raw IPs, raw responses, raw Mode Pack JSON, raw registry manifests, prompts, provider responses, file content, command output, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets
existing authorization, HTTPS-only, no-redirect, content-type, byte-limit, expected-hash, compile, provenance, signer trust, revocation, and replay invariants remain intact
no new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or wrapper surface is added
next_phase_after_r5_1: R5.2 Active Mode Pack Candidate Identity if phase completion review confirms the fetch boundary is closed
